subject: SKU bucket mapping, reseller pass-through & proforma for marketplace pricing
messages:
From: Kevin Liu <kevin@alpha-analytics.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: cloud-spark-sales@cloudspark.io
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace pricing proforma + reseller pass-through question

Hi Priya / Vanessa,

We're getting close to an internal approval for the AWS private offer but procurement needs a clear proforma that maps Redwood SKUs to our internal billing buckets and shows the reseller pass-through margin. Two asks from our side: 

1) A simple proforma that lists SKU, unit price, list vs net (with proposed discount tiers) and the line showing reseller pass-through (what CloudSpark would invoice us).
2) Confirmation on whether Redwood can do a 12m vs 24m commit with different effective unit prices (we want to see a 12m conservative commit and a 24m incentivized rate).

Can you send a quick draft proforma and a SKU-bucket CSV we can drop into our finance system? Also include any limits or minimums for marketplace private offers.

Thanks,
Kevin Liu
Partner Ops
Alpha Analytics
kevin@alpha-analytics.com

P.S. CCing CloudSpark (our reseller) so they have visibility on pass-through ask.

From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Kevin Liu <kevin@alpha-analytics.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, cloud-spark-sales@cloudspark.io
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace pricing proforma + reseller pass-through question

Thanks Kevin — appreciate the clarity. Attaching a first-pass proforma and the SKU->billing bucket mapping you can load into your finance system. Highlights below: 

- Attachment: alpha_proforma_v1.xlsx (contains per-SKU list price, proposed net under 12m and 24m commits, and suggested reseller pass-through line).
- Attachment: sku_bucket_map.csv (simple two-column mapping for ingestion).
- We can support both 12m and 24m commits. 24m gets an incremental discount tier (see sheet “Commit_Tiers”).
- For AWS private offer flow: we’ll publish the private offer via AWS Marketplace; CloudSpark will be the transactable reseller if you want reseller invoicing. Redwood can also invoice directly under a Dedicated contract if required (different billing flow).

Open items for us to finalize: pass-through percentage for CloudSpark (commercially they typically take 5–12% depending on ARR and whether they act as reseller vs distributor), any custom SKU bundling you need, and whether you want an upfront prepay vs monthly usage reconciliation.

If it helps, Marcus can suggest margin floor and a simple waterfall to show net to Redwood, net to CloudSpark and final cost to Alpha.

Next steps: Marcus / Vanessa — can you review the draft proforma and confirm what pass-through % range we want to propose to Alpha? I flagged two optional columns in the spreadsheet: "reseller_net_pct" and "redwood_net_after_commission."

Thanks,

Priya Natarajan
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwood.com

[Attachment: alpha_proforma_v1.xlsx (xlsx)]
[Attachment: sku_bucket_map.csv (csv)]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Kevin Liu <kevin@alpha-analytics.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace pricing proforma + reseller pass-through question

Nice starter proforma. A few detailed asks from rev ops so Alpha has a clean view and our finance team can forecast: 

1) Waterfall: please add a three-line waterfall per SKU showing: list -> Redwood net after platform discounts -> CloudSpark pass-through -> Alpha effective price. That makes audit easier.
2) Margin floors: propose we set a CloudSpark pass-through band of 6–10% for this deal given their committed uplift (they're taking sales/support). If Alpha commits to a 24m + 20% uplift vs year 1 usage, we can push to 6%. For a 12m small commit keep 9–10%.
3) SKU bucketing: recommend grouping by average concurrency class (small, standard, high). Finance prefers fewer bucket types. I sketched 3 buckets in sku_bucket_map.csv but can collapse to two if Alpha prefers.
4) Billing line examples: include a sample invoice with three lines mapping to each bucket (unit price, quantity, extended). Procurement always asks to see that.

Vanessa / Priya: if we can lock the pass-through ranges and the invoice example I can draft the HubSpot deal note and the ARR forecast assumption.

Marcus Lin
Head, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com

[Inline: suggested waterfall example included in sheet "revops_notes"]

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Kevin Liu <kevin@alpha-analytics.com>, cloud-spark-sales@cloudspark.io
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace pricing proforma + reseller pass-through question

Thanks — quick clarifications from GTM/partnerships: 

- CloudSpark pass-through: functionally they will bill Alpha as the reseller. Our standard commercial guidance for marketplace private offers is to allow a 5–12% pass-through band. For this SKU mix and given CloudSpark’s involvement, propose we offer the following: 12m commit = 9% pass-through (default), 24m commit = 6% pass-through (incentivized). We can flex to 5% if CloudSpark provides guaranteed joint-SDR coverage and a 20% uplift on commit within 60 days.
- Commit anatomy: we can anchor on list price, provide an effective net after Redwood discount, then show the CloudSpark line as an additive invoice credit (so Alpha sees the final amount).
- Terms: we'll attach Redwood marketplace terms (redwood_marketplace_terms_v2.pdf) and call out that additional support work, custom integrations or on-prem options are out-of-scope of the proforma and will be quoted separately.

I've uploaded an example invoice layout to the Drive link Priya included (Drive doc: "Alpha — Marketplace Proforma (example invoice lines)").

Action items: Priya — please update the proforma with the two pass-through rows (12m/24m) and add the sample invoice lines Marcus requested. After that I'll send the commercial summary to CloudSpark and AWS Marketplace sales to validate the PO flow.

Vanessa Ortiz
Director, GTM Partnerships
Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com

[Attachment: redwood_marketplace_terms_v2.pdf (pdf)]

From: Sophie Martin <sophie@alpha-analytics.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Kevin Liu <kevin@alpha-analytics.com>, cloud-spark-sales@cloudspark.io, aws-marketplace-sales@amazon.com
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 17:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace pricing proforma + reseller pass-through question

Thanks everyone — this is helpful. Sophie from procurement here. A couple quick items before we route to our finance approvals: 

1) The 24m numbers look compelling — Alpha will aim for the 24m commit with the 6% pass-through subject to final invoice example. Can you include explicit invoice lines for (i) platform charges, (ii) reseller fee, (iii) taxes? We need a sample invoice for our AP team.
2) Please add a one-page summary that calls out escalation contacts for SLA exceptions and who to route billing disputes to (AP + Redwood billing).
3) Final: once we have the updated proforma and invoice example, we'll run it through our legal for a 10-business-day turn. If everything is in order we'll accept the private offer path with CloudSpark as reseller.

Appreciate the speed here — can Priya confirm expected timeline for updated XLSX and CSV?

Best,
Sophie Martin
Procurement Manager
Alpha Analytics
sophie@alpha-analytics.com

[Requested next: updated alpha_proforma_v1.xlsx with invoice lines, updated sku_bucket_map.csv]
